snippet.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Reveal Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Fifteen years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, young Sophia seeks her independence as a fierce plunderer in the unforgiving world of the 14th century.

Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy will be released on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox PC and Xbox Cloud in 2026, and will be available day one with Xbox Game Pass - Wishlist today!
